messages.summary:
## Objective
- Update the existing Turbo Toad Rally game with a more detailed race track, a horizontal start/finish line across a straight, and visibly different vehicle types.

## Requirements
- Build/apply changes directly without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Provide a complete, playable game.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Replaced the oval circuit with a rounded-rectangle layout featuring a long horizontal start/finish straight.
- Added race-track details including textured asphalt, kerbs, guide stripes, grid boxes, fencing, grandstand, landscaping, and a start arch.
- Used a player go-kart and bus, pickup, and tractor opponents.

## Work State
### Completed
- Reworked track, scenery, start grid, and start/finish arch in `game.js`.
- Added distinct go-kart, bus, pickup, and tractor models and updated the start screen description in `index.html`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved/read the latest screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/rally-start.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate screenshot appearance and test gameplay controls/race progression.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/rally-start.jpg` for visual issues; capture a new screenshot after any changes.
2. Start a race in the browser and verify steering, vehicles, lap progression, and start/finish orientation.
3. Run final syntax/status checks and report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: track geometry, scenery, vehicle models, and gameplay loop.
- `index.html`: game title and start-screen copy.
- `/tmp/opencode/rally-start.jpg`: latest visual-check screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Development server is available at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Initial browser console showed a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL read-pixel performance warnings; no reported JavaScript errors.
